Subject: Initial vendor intake: tax IDs, VAT & PO setup (BluePeak Analytics)

Hi Lia —

Thanks for agreeing to work with Redwood. To get finance set up so we can issue a PO and enable billing, can you please provide the following items by end of week if possible: 

- Signed tax form: W-9 (US entities) OR W-8BEN-E (foreign entities). Please use your legal company name as registered.
- VAT registration or certificate (if applicable) + VAT number to include on invoices.
- Completed bank account form (attached sample for reference) with account name exactly matching legal entity.
- A sample invoice showing line items, currency, and remittance instructions.
- Point of contact for billing/questions + CLA/SSO contact if different from billing.

If you expect any delays or need clarification on which form to use, let me know and we can loop in Finance. Once we receive completed docs, Finance typically creates a vendor profile and issues a PO within 3 business days.

Attachments: procurement_bank_account_template.xlsx (please complete & return)

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A couple quick items from Finance review: 

- The bank form needs the payee name to match the legal name exactly as on tax docs. Please update bank account form to read: "BluePeak Analytics, Inc." (including ", Inc.").
- On the W-8BEN-E we see FATCA classification filled, but for our records Finance requires either a W-9 (if BluePeak has a US tax classification) or a completed W-8 with a foreign TIN and signature — can you confirm which applies. You mentioned EIN 12-3456789; if you are a US entity please send a W-9 instead.
- Please also add a sample invoice (PDF) that includes the VAT number and the billing address you want on the PO.
